question: Why does a prism separate white light into colours while a rectangular glass slab does not produce a visible spectrum? Give reason using refraction.

options.A: A rectangular glass slab produces a spectrum because its opposite faces are parallel, while a prism does not.
options.B: A prism and a glass slab both produce the same visible spectrum because both are made of glass.
options.C: In a prism, the refracting faces are inclined, so the deviations at its two faces add and different colours emerge in different directions. In a rectangular slab, opposite faces are parallel, so the emergent rays are nearly parallel and mainly show lateral displacement rather than a visible spectrum.
options.D: A glass slab disperses more than a prism because its faces are parallel.
